annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes Foursage by claiming easy income without work, including 20 USD through teamwork and 5,600 in one day, then directly encourages viewers to join through a contact. The earnings claim is tied to participation in a team-based structure, making recruitment-dependent income the central solicitation rather than neutral financial commentary.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the speaker links earnings to teamwork and invites viewers to join the Foursage structure. The video presents team-based income claims and a direct recruitment pathway, rather than merely mentioning a one-level referral or discussing cryptocurrency generally.
